scripts.install:all: bun install && cd api && bun install && cd ../web && bun install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "bun run dev:api" "bun run dev:web"
scripts.test: cd api && bun test && cd ../web && bun run test:vitest
scripts.typecheck: cd api && bun run typecheck && cd ../web && bun run typecheck
